questions.questionText: Which word means the same as big?
Which word is the opposite of day?

questions.passage: Nina walked to the pond with her red mittens. She threw a snowball at the old pine tree. When she got home, only one mitten was left in her pocket.
The campers woke up when the sun came over the hill. Sam stirred the oatmeal in a big pot. Everyone ate two bowls before the morning hike.

questions.questionText: The trail was narrow. What does narrow mean?
Which word best completes the sentence? The bear moved ______ so it would not wake the cubs.

questions.passage: Aya's compass needle always pointed north, even when the trail curved. Her group followed the river instead, because the map showed the camp was downstream. By noon they could smell woodsmoke from the campfire.
questions.questionText: Why did the group follow the river instead of the compass?

options.text: The map showed camp was downstream

questions.passage: Ben stayed up past bedtime because his uncle promised the sky would glow. At first there was nothing but stars. Then a green ribbon slid across the dark, and Ben forgot how cold his hands were.
questions.questionText: How did Ben feel when the lights appeared?

options.text: Amazed enough to forget the cold

questions.questionText: The guide was reluctant to cross the ice. Reluctant means:
Which word is closest in meaning to abundant?

questions.passage: Every winter the road to the village freezes solid enough to carry trucks. Drivers move slowly, not because the ice is weak, but because speed sends a wave through the water beneath it. That wave can crack the surface far ahead of the truck itself.
questions.questionText: Why do drivers keep their speed low on the ice road?

options.text: The ice is too thin to hold a truck
Speed creates a wave under the ice that can crack it
Trucks use less fuel when slow

questions.passage: The old map showed the creek running east of the ridge. The new survey put it west. Rather than argue, the scouts walked the ridge themselves and found the creek had simply changed course after the flood.
questions.questionText: What is the main idea of this passage?

options.text: Checking for yourself explained why both maps differed
The scouts got lost on the ridge
